project_title: AuraStay - Rental Marketplace & Agency Management Platform
theme: Light theme preferred for guest catalogue (warm Mediterranean bone-white & sandstone background with charcoal text), dark/zinc contrast accent surfaces for financial clarity

headings.h1_catalogue: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-stone-900 font-display
headings.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-800 font-display
headings.h4_widget: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-stone-800 uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_dark: backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-900/80 border border-stone-800/80 shadow-lg text-white
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards/modals, rounded-xl for inputs/buttons, rounded-full for badges/pills

guest_frontend.first_screen: MUST start directly with the functional Property Catalogue (search bar, filter pills, dates, price slider, and grid of properties). NOT a generic centered marketing splash.
guest_frontend.header: Sticky header with glassmorphism backdrop (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200/80 z-40`). Left: AuraStay logo + Agency switcher dropdown; Right: Currency indicator (€ EUR), Saved Favorites trigger, Reservation Status lookup button, and Workspace Dashboard Switcher CTA ('Agency Workspace').

catalogue_page.search_and_filter_bar: Integrated top bar with Location input, Date Range Picker (Check-in / Check-out), Guests count, Price Range slider (€50 - €1,000+), Amenities multiselect, and Sorting dropdown (Price Low-High, Price High-Low, Rating, Popularity).
catalogue_page.grid_layout: Responsive Tetris grid (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6`). Property cards feature high-res photo carousel, location badge, price per night with mono font, agency tag, and instant reservation fee pill (€10 - €30).

property_detail_modal_or_page.layout: 2-column layout (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8`). Left 7 cols: Photo grid/gallery, description, specs (bedrooms, baths, guests), complete amenities checklist, agency host profile, map placeholder. Right 5 cols: Sticky Booking & Fee Calculation Widget (`sticky top-24`).
property_detail_modal_or_page.fee_calculator_widget: Calculates: Nightly stay total = Rate * Nights. Extra services selected (e.g. Airport Transfer +€45, Cleaning +€30). Calculates non-refundable reservation fee dynamic formula: Base €10 + 3% of total stay (capped between €10 and €30).
property_detail_modal_or_page.booking_flow: Step 1: Guest details (Name, Email, Phone, Arrival time, Special requests). Step 2: Clear financial summary breakdown showing (Accommodation Total paid upon arrival to agency, Non-refundable instant reservation fee paid now via Whop). Step 3: Whop checkout button with simulated live mode notice and instant booking status generation.

reservation_status_page.component: Dedicated view accessible via booking code search or direct link after reservation fee checkout. Shows booking reference number, QR code placeholder, reservation fee confirmation receipt (€), payment status (Fee Paid / Booking Inquiry Sent), breakdown of balance due at check-in, host contact info, and cancellation terms.

agency_workspace.header_and_navigation: Top toolbar with Agency Context Switcher ('Iberian Estates', 'Costa Luxe', 'Balearic Stays' or 'All Agencies [Platform Admin]'), Live Platform Fee Indicator ('Platform Fee: 2% of accommodation gross'), User badge, and Navigation Tabs.

tab_1_dashboard.title: Dashboard & Financial Reports
kpi_cards: Agency Net Earnings (€ - Host share after 2% platform fee)
Platform Fee Paid (€ - 2% of total full accommodation price)
Non-Refundable Booking Fees Collected (€10 - €30 per booking)
tab_1_dashboard.charts: Recharts visual bar/area charts showing monthly revenue split (Agency Share vs Platform 2% Fee), occupancy trends, and reservation volume by property.
tab_1_dashboard.recent_reservations_table: Interactive table of recent bookings with status filters (Fee Paid, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled), fee paid badge, check-in dates, and view detail modal.

tab_2_properties.title: Property Portfolio Management
tab_2_properties.action: Log New Property CTA button opening rich multi-step form modal.
tab_2_properties.form_fields: Property Name, City/Address, Property Type (Apartment, Villa, Penthouse, Chalet), Nightly Price (€), Agency Commission Rate (10% to 20%), Max Guests, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Amenities tags, Image Upload / URL manager, Extra Accompaniment Services list (Service Name + Price in €).
tab_2_properties.calendar_blocker: Interactive date grid per property allowing agency host to toggle availability blocks (Block Dates for maintenance / personal use).

tab_3_commissions.title: Commissions & Platform Settlements
tab_3_commissions.summary: Clear calculation explanation card: Platform deducts 2% of FULL accommodation price from the agency's gross commission.
tab_3_commissions.table: Per-property financial breakdown: Total Reservations, Total Accommodation Sales (€), Agency Gross Commission (€ based on 10%-20% rate), Platform 2% Fee (€), Agency Net Payout (€), Settlement Status (Paid / Pending), and Action: Download CSV Statement.

tab_4_team.title: Team & Operations Directory
tab_4_team.action: Add Team Member modal (Name, Role: Property Manager, Commercial Agent, Cleaning Staff, Maintenance Tech, Phone, Email, Assigned Properties, Hourly/Contract Rate €).
tab_4_team.view: Grid of team cards with quick status pills (On Duty, Off Duty, On Site) and assignment tags.

tab_5_expenses.title: Property Expenses Management
tab_5_expenses.action: Log Expense CTA button (Select Property, Expense Category: Repair, Lock/Key, Cleaning, Furniture, Utilities, Amount in €, Date, Vendor/Description, Receipt attachment toggle).
tab_5_expenses.table: Filterable expense log by property and category, total monthly expenses summary card, and CSV Export button.

testing_and_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, card, and key data display element MUST include a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-sided application: Guest Catalogue & Reservation Experience on the front, and 5-page Agency & Platform Management Workspace on the back.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes and Shadcn components where relevant. Remember files are Javascript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Never apply universal CSS transition (e.g. 'transition: all') to avoid breaking transforms.
Do NOT use pure transparent background in sticky headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or heavily blurred background (e.g. `backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-stone-200`).
Ensure all monetary values are formatted in Euros (€) with clear 2% platform fee mathematical transparency across the Dashboard and Commission pages.
Whop fee-only checkout flow should be interactive with clear non-refundable reservation fee calculations (€10 to €30 depending on property stay duration and total cost).
Include sample seed data for at least 4 realistic European properties, 5 agency team members, 6 reservations, and 4 expense entries so the app feels rich and immediately testable.
